init_ObjectTargetSampler: create an ObjectTargetSampler instance with a list of ManagedRigidObject instances for target sampling
sample_object_targets: call sample on ObjectTargetSampler to place objects into target receptacles within the Habitat simulator
review_ObjectTargetSampler_sample: review the ObjectTargetSampler sample method to understand how it maps instances without replacement
refactor_ObjectTargetSampler_validation: refactor the ObjectTargetSampler sample method to add custom validation for target and goal receptacle counts
summarize_ObjectTargetSampler: summarize the ObjectTargetSampler class which extends ObjectSampler to sample from specific object instances instead of templates
